module_summary: 16x16 sequential multiplier wrapper: a one-hot idle/run/finish FSM loads operands into a shift-add core child on start, steps it until its last flag, then pulses done.

anchors.name: w
anchors.why: One-hot state (idle/run/finish) sequencing load, stepping and completion of the core.

anchors.name: s
anchors.why: Start input: in idle loads operands into core and enters run.

anchors.name: a
anchors.why: Multiplicand operand passed to the core.

anchors.name: b
anchors.why: Multiplier operand passed to the core.

anchors.name: p
anchors.why: Product output, driven by the core accumulator.

anchors.name: d
anchors.why: One-cycle done pulse from fin register after the finish state.

anchors.name: bz
anchors.why: Busy level while FSM is in the run state.

anchors.name: hot_r
anchors.why: Run-state decode driving the core go/step enable.

anchors.name: ends
anchors.why: Core step-counter completion flag; moves FSM run to finish.

anchors.name: hot_i
anchors.why: Idle-state decode; with start forms the core load strobe.

anchors.name: hot_f
anchors.why: Finish-state decode registered into fin for the done pulse.

groups.name: sequencer
groups.description: One-hot FSM issuing load and step to the core until its last flag.

groups.name: multiplier_core
groups.description: um_core shift-add multiplier child producing the 32-bit product.

groups.name: status_out
groups.description: Done pulse register and busy level outputs.
